It wasn't until February 17, 1801, on the 35th ballot, that the deadlock broke: Vermont and Maryland abstained, giving Jefferson the votes of ten states and the presidency. The crisis directly prompted the adoption of the Twelfth Amendment in 1804, which provided for separate electoral ballots for president and vice president.

Legend holds his face was recognized in part because wolves had partially eaten the body.

The horn antenna used by Arno Penzias and Robert Wilson in their 1964 discovery of the cosmic microwave background radiation was located at the Bell Telephone Laboratories facility in Murray Hill, New Jersey.
